title: Local Marketing: A Complete Guide | Salesforce

facts.fact: Salesforce's own research reports that 80% of shoppers say the experience a company provides is just as important as its products or service.
facts.quote: 80% of shoppers say that the experience a company provides is just as important as its products or service

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical bakery example, a $1,000 broad online ad campaign across the entire city reached 10,000 people, yielding 100 customers and a 1% conversion rate.
facts.quote: This campaign reaches 10,000 people, but only 100 of them convert into customers, resulting in a conversion rate of 1%.

facts.fact: In the page's hypothetical bakery example, the same $1,000 spent on Facebook ads targeted to a 5-mile radius around the storefront reached 2,500 people and yielded 200 customers, an 8% conversion rate.
facts.quote: However, due to the relevance of the ads and their proximity to the bakery, 200 people convert into customers, doubling the conversion rate to 8%.

facts.fact: The hypothetical bakery example used a $1,000 budget for both the broad campaign and the localized Facebook campaign.
facts.quote: they invest the same $1,000 in targeted Facebook ads specifically aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of their storefront

facts.fact: Salesforce's State of Marketing report promotion states it draws on nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.
